metadata.description: Plugins by Lee. Currently home to Cadence, a configurable project-management methodology.

plugins.name: cadence
plugins.description: A configurable project-management methodology: vision -> roadmap -> epics -> tickets -> gates, worked in bounded sessions. Binds to your tracker/VCS/docs via adapters and to your team's process via a flow spec (solo, team-sprints, live-oncall, or your own).
